title: Avatar System Decisions
summary: Steffen 1 + Steffen 2 coordination document. Avatar system decisions, style direction, character proportions, color palette consistency.
content:
Avatar System Decisions

Steffen 1 + Steffen 2 | 2026-03-16 One creative director, two hands.

DECISION 1: Dual Style System (CONFIRMED)

We maintain TWO character styles, not one. They coexist in the catalog.

Style A: Pixel-Warm (Default, Production)

  • Current sprites in /corner/sprites/
  • 13 agents x 4 states = 52 state sprites
  • 13 agents x 4 directions = 52 walk sprites
  • Total: 104 character assets
  • These are IN PRODUCTION. Bobby's live build uses them.
  • DO NOT change or replace these without a migration plan.

Style B: Crossy Road Chunky (Style Pack, Exploration)

  • 4 characters generated (Bobby, Elon, Cleo, Steffen)
  • At /visual-target/crossy-road-style/character-*.png
  • 9 more needed (Mom, Alex, Steve, Jacob, Tony, Colton, Elmo, Patrik, Pixel)
  • These are CATALOG items for the marketplace/style pack feature
  • Not yet integrated into the live build

Why Both

The product supports style packs (per Patrik's direction). Default style is pixel-warm. Crossy Road is the first alternate style pack. Users choose. Both need to be complete sets.

DECISION 2: Character Proportions

Pixel-Warm Style

  • Head: ~40% of body height
  • Body: standard proportions, slightly chibi
  • Size at overview zoom: 24-30px
  • Size at detail zoom: 64-80px
  • Size in HUD portraits: 42px (plumbob clip)

Crossy Road Style

  • Head: ~50% of body height (more exaggerated)
  • Body: blocky, 4-5 voxels wide
  • Minimum readable size: 24px (must still read in HUD pills)
  • Maximum detail size: 128px (room close-up)
  • Characters should be recognizable at ANY size between 24-128px
  • The key: PROPS + SIGNATURE COLOR identify the agent, not facial detail

Cross-Style Consistency

  • Both styles use the SAME signature colors per agent
  • Both styles use the SAME props per agent (Bobby = headphones + laptop, Elon = wrench + server, etc.)
  • Both styles occupy the SAME grid footprint (1x1 sub-cell for standing character)
  • The sprite state system (idle, thinking, speaking, done) applies to BOTH styles

DECISION 3: Agent Signature Colors (LOCKED)

These are canonical. Both styles use these. HUD uses these. Room tinting uses these.

Agent Color Hex Notes

Mom Orange-Red #E85D26 AOM brand accent. Energy.
Alex Blue #3B82F6 Strategy. Clear, professional.

Steffen Golden #FFB74D Creative warmth. (Shares palette with Patrik, differentiated by props)
Bobby Purple #9C27B0 Developer. Night owl. LED energy.
Colton Indigo #5C6BC0 Builder. Bobby's complement.
Cleo Coral/Orange #FF7043 Content. Warm, creative.
Tony Pink #EC407A Social media. Bold, attention.
Jacob Green-Gold #8BC34A Outreach. Growth.
Elmo Red #EF4444 QA. Alert. Scrutiny.
Elon Green #4CAF50 Infrastructure. Systems.

Note on Steffen + Patrik sharing gold: Steffen's golden is paint/easel/creative warmth. Patrik's amber is authority/premium. The hex is close but the context (props, room, role) differentiates them completely. If Bobby needs distinct hex codes for rendering, use Steffen: #FFB74D, Patrik: #FFA726.

DECISION 4: Agent Props (LOCKED)

These props identify each agent across ALL sizes and styles. Even at 24px, the prop + color must be enough.

Agent Primary Prop Secondary Prop Scene Props
Patrik Camera Coffee mug Premium desk, clean setup
Mom Clipboard Headset Status icons floating around her
Alex Globe Strategy book Business suit
Steve Laptop (schema visible) Glasses Calculator, database icon
Steffen Paint palette Easel Round glasses, turtleneck
Bobby Purple headphones Laptop Purple LED underglow
Colton Dual monitors Component blocks Organized desk
Cleo Film camera Clapperboard Orange scarf/bandana
Tony Ring light Multiple phones Social media screens
Jacob Phone to ear Business cards Phoenix map pin
Elmo Magnifying glass Red pen Lab coat, checklist
Elon Wrench Server rack Green glowing eyes
Pixel Extension icon Code brackets Cyan digital particles

DECISION 5: Avatar States

Both styles must support these 5 states. The HUD and game read the state to show the correct sprite/animation.

State Pixel-Warm Expression Crossy Road Expression
idle Sitting at desk, relaxed posture Standing on platform, gentle bob
working Typing, focused lean forward Bouncing in place, arms moving
speaking Mouth open, hand gesture Bouncing higher, speech bubble voxel
thinking Hand on chin, thought bubble Tilted head, rotating question mark voxel
done Leaned back, checkmark Victory hop, star particles

For Crossy Road style specifically:

  • Every state should involve MOVEMENT. Nothing is ever truly still.
  • Idle = gentle bob (2px up/down, 3s cycle)
  • Working = faster bob + arm animation
  • Speaking = hop + speech indicator
  • Thinking = slow tilt rotation
  • Done = big celebratory bounce

OPEN QUESTIONS (Steffen 2 to decide, Steffen 1 to confirm)

  1. Walk animations for Crossy Road style: Do characters hop between squares (like Crossy Road) or slide (like current pixel-warm)? Recommendation: HOP. It's the defining motion of Crossy Road. Each step is a discrete bounce to the next tile.

  2. HUD avatar size in Crossy Road mode: Should HUD portraits switch to chunky voxel style when the user selects Crossy Road theme? Or keep pixel-warm portraits in HUD regardless? Recommendation: SWITCH. The HUD and game should feel like ONE product.

  3. Character customization scope: For the marketplace, can users customize colors/props on their agents? Or are agents fixed designs? Recommendation: Fixed base design + unlockable accessories. The base character (Bobby with purple headphones) is always recognizable. Accessories are additions, not replacements.

FOR STEFFEN 2: Next Priorities

  1. Generate remaining 9 Crossy Road characters (Mom, Alex, Steve, Jacob, Tony, Colton, Elmo, Patrik, Pixel). Use the props and colors locked above. Save to visual-target/crossy-road-style/character-*.png
  2. Generate HUD visual target with Crossy Road characters in the portrait slots. Overlay on the game view. Save to visual-target/hud-target.png
  3. Decide on the 3 open questions above and update this document with your reasoning
  4. Generate avatar state sheet for 2-3 agents showing all 5 states in Crossy Road style. This becomes the animation reference for Bobby.

This document is append-only for decisions. Both Steffens edit. Decisions are final once marked LOCKED.
